subject: CSR staging + shadow DNS orchestration for FinBank private endpoints

To: Mike Liu <mike.liu@finbank.com>, engops@finbank.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05 09:12 -07:00
Subject: CSR staging + shadow DNS orchestration for FinBank private endpoints

Hi Mike / EngOps team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Following up with a concise plan for how we propose to stage CSRs and validate TLS for the FinBank private endpoints without touching prod DNS or cert trust anchors. Goal: enable FinBank to test routing + certificate rotation flows in a staging VPC, exercise the CSR lifecycle automation, and run a short canary before any production cutover.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Shadow DNS in staging: we will create a split-horizon zone in your staging resolver where the private hostnames point to our staging gateways. No changes to production zones.
- CSR staging flow: Redwood will generate CSRs signed by an intermediate test CA (customer-managed) you can import into your trust store; we will also support an offline CSR bundle if your security team prefers manual ingestion.
- ACME vs offline: for staging we recommend a short-lived ACME-issued cert (90d) or an intermediate-signed cert with a 7d rotation window to exercise rotation logic. Production strategy can be locked later.
- Validation steps: automated TLS probe from inside FinBank staging VPC + client-side validation using your service account certs.

I've attached a runbook and a quick wiring diagram. Can you confirm the staging resolver FQDNs and whether you prefer the ACME path or an offline signed bundle for the initial test?

Next steps: if you confirm, we’ll schedule a 60-minute runbook walkthrough and provision the temporary certs.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rbw-csr-staging-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook), finbank-shadow-dns-wires.png (diagram)
From: Mike Liu <mike.liu@finbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>, engops@finbank.com
Date: 2026-09-05 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSR staging + shadow DNS orchestration for FinBank private endpoints

Jordan — thanks for the thorough summary. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock a path: 

1) Staging resolver: staging-resolver.finbank.internal (managed by our infra team) is the correct place. We will provide ACLs for the Redwood staging gateway IPs.
2) Trust model: our security team is wary of automated ACME flows in any environment that mimics production. For the initial test we prefer an offline intermediate-signed bundle that we can inspect and import.
3) Rotation window: 7d is fine for a test; will your automation demonstrate an automated rotation and rollback if validation fails?

Also, any constraints about the CSR fields (SAN, TTL expectations) we should know? I'll loop in our compliance lead if necessary.

—Mike
Senior EngOps Manager
FinBank
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mike Liu <mike.liu@finbank.com>, engops@finbank.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05 13:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSR staging + shadow DNS orchestration for FinBank private endpoints

Mike — perfect, thanks for the quick answers. Summary and commitments: 

- We will use your staging resolver (staging-resolver.finbank.internal). Please add inbound ACLs for these temporary staging CIDRs: 10.240.18.0/26 and 35.199.120.64/26.
- We'll deliver an offline intermediate-signed certificate bundle for the initial run. The bundle will include a short-lived intermediate (7d) and a signed server cert for the staging FQDNs.
- Rotation & rollback: Redwood's staging automation will demonstrate the full rotation pipeline: generate CSR -> send offline bundle to you (SFTP or signed Drive link) -> you import and return an ack -> our probes validate chain and SNI -> if validation fails we automatically attempt a rollback to the previous cert and raise an alert (we'll demo both successful and failed paths).
- CSR details: SANs will be explicit FQDNs only (no wildcards) and we will include the canonical service CN as requested. TTL/validity fields: server cert 7 days, intermediate 9 days.

I've attached a trimmed runbook that maps the exact command snippets we'll run and the probe checks (tcp:443 SNI, OCSP stapling check, and an application-level health endpoint that validates client cert acceptance).

Proposed schedule: Walkthrough Friday 2026-09-07 10:00 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and the SFTP details.

Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>, Mike Liu <mike.liu@finbank.com>, engops@finbank.com
Date: 2026-09-06 08:01 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSR staging + shadow DNS orchestration for FinBank private endpoints

Quick operational notes from our side before the walkthrough: 

- Audit trail: we will enable an audit entry for every CSR operation (who requested, CSR fingerprint, timestamp) and include the entries in the demo.
- Key custody: Redwood will generate the CSR and private key initially in our staging HSM-backed KMS; if FinBank prefers keys generated in your environment we can flip the model to a CSR-only upload. Please confirm preference during the call.
- Test failure policy: for the demo we will simulate a failure path where the new cert fails OCSP stapling; rollback will be automatic but we will show the log sequence and the HubSpot ticket generated automatically for compliance.

Also tagging Grace and Karthik — Grace, please prepare the probe scripts; Karthik, please review the runbook for any missing SNI or ALPN requirements.

Laura
PM, Product (Security & Deployments)
Redwood Inference

Compliance confirmed that they want the private key verification step done on our side for the first run; we will import the intermediate and server cert, run the probes, and provide an import ack by EOD Friday if all checks pass.

Thanks for the clear plan and runbook — see you Friday.

—Mike
